title: ABBAReasoningAssuranceContract
principle: ABBA may reason across artifacts, but no reasoning artifact is itself authority.
separationRules: THEORY is an explanatory model, not evidence.
HYPOTHESIS is a testable proposition, not evidence or a result.
OBSERVATION is an observed input, not automatically evidence or truth.
EVIDENCE supports or challenges a claim; it is not truth by itself.
RESULT is the outcome of a defined procedure; it is not a conclusion.
CONCLUSION is a reasoned synthesis grounded in referenced evidence/results; it is not a recommendation.
RECOMMENDATION is an action proposal derived from context and conclusions; it is not authorization.
DECISION is a recorded decision artifact; authority and consent must still be independently validated by the governance gate.
governanceRules: Authority is never inferred by ABBA from a reasoning artifact.
No reasoning artifact may self-authorize consequential execution.
Contradictory or insufficient basis remains explicitly marked rather than silently promoted.
All reasoning remains attributable, provenance-bound and reconstructable.
confidenceRule: Confidence describes the assessment of an artifact, not the truth status of the world.
executionRule: Only the independent Authority + Policy + Consent Gate can permit consequential execution.
